## Suggest a paper for the Library

Send the title or the DOI of a work on populism, and a line on why it belongs in the [Library](../library/index.qmd).

## Join the Zotero group

The Library lives in a public Zotero group called "PopuliVerse Library". Scholars who suggest papers regularly are invited to join it as editors.

## Write for Commentary

Commentary publishes short pieces of 800 to 1,500 words by PhD holders and doctoral candidates. See the [call and the submission guidelines](../commentary/index.qmd#call-for-commentary).

## Report an error or ask for a reply

If something published here is wrong, write to the editor. Corrections are made in the open, never silently. A person or party discussed in an issue may also ask for a short reply. Both are described in the [editorial policy](editorial-policy.qmd).
